verdicts.reason: A: the date/address text is tiny and hard to read, the window has moved to the far left out of its original order, everything is crammed into the left-centre third, and a large empty area sits on the right, so the layout looks lopsided. B: keeps the original left-to-right order of headline, window and details across the full width with readable text sizes and balanced spacing; the only weakness is a fairly small window graphic.
